in_sanskrit.name: Mabu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intelligent, Wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mabu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mabu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mati' which means 'intelligence' and 'Budhi' which means 'wisdom'. The name Mabu is a perfect name for a child who is believed to be intelligent and wise even before they are born.
